# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Sync from Core
# writes, in order: POST /api/payload-catalog/sync
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-root div.pd-refusal: The catalog sync failed: the Edge refused it.
    notice: error "the Edge refused it"
    sheet: closed
    state: settingsError="The catalog sync failed: the Edge refused it."
    unhandled rejection: none
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-root div.pd-refusal: The catalog sync failed: Server error (500).
    notice: error "Server error (500)"
    sheet: closed
    state: settingsError="The catalog sync failed: Server error (500)."
    unhandled rejection: none
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-root div.pd-refusal: The catalog sync failed: No answer from the server.
    notice: error "No answer from the server"
    sheet: closed
    state: settingsError="The catalog sync failed: No answer from the server."
    unhandled rejection: none
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-root div.pd-refusal: The catalog sync failed: Signed out.
    new text: .notice-root span.notice-text: Signed out
    new text: .notice-root a.notice-action: Sign in
    notice: error "Signed out" (sticky) · Sign in → /login?next=%2Fprocesses%3Fprocess%3D1
    sheet: closed
    state: settingsError="The catalog sync failed: Signed out."
    unhandled rejection: none
